label: Groundwater table (GWT)
detail: Drawn above the tank invert: the high water table case this anchorage is built for.

label: Sand backfill
detail: Fills the 300 to 600 mm working space between the base edge and the pit wall, compacted in 150 mm layers up to the opening rim.

label: FRP bio-filter tank, horizontal series
detail: Diameter 1500 to 1700 mm (drawn schematically); filled with water to top water level before backfilling.

label: Anchor strap, Ø20 mm SS304
detail: Tied over the tank and tightened with a stainless steel turnbuckle, so buoyancy is resisted by the straps and the base.

label: Anchor hooks, Ø12 mm stainless steel
detail: Four hooks cast into the concrete base to take the straps.

label: Concrete base, 150 mm grade 30 N
detail: Reinforced with one layer of BRC-A9 wire mesh, on 50 mm lean concrete.

label: Inlet and outlet pipes, 150 mm
detail: Both laid at a 1:100 drop gradient; invert levels TBC.

label: Concrete slab, 100 mm 1:2:4
detail: Laid over the tank with one layer of BRC-A9 wire mesh and manhole openings.

label: Brick sump manhole necks and covers
detail: Brick sump necks connect the slab's manhole openings to the manhole covers.
